scope: Read-only physical contact-numbering review of the existing U214/U219 Cap slot. This evidence is not an approved contact map, placement instruction, or fabrication release.

reviewed_native_pose.view: Native PCB F-side, increasing X right, increasing Y down. Cavity and its corresponding outer solder tail retain the same physical number.

manufacturer_facts: Samtec drawing HLE-1XX-02-XX-DV-XE-XX revision AI, sheet 1 Figure 1 numbers adjacent rows 01/02 and successive columns as odd/even pairs.
Section A-A shows each contact continuing from its own cavity to its same-side outward tail; no internal row crossover is shown.
The -DV option is double vertical and -PE is pass-through entry. Mating is normal to the carrier PCB, despite the historical KiCad footprint name ending in Horizontal.
Mating cavity row separation is 0.100 inch (2.54 mm); outer tail-row separation is 0.300 inch (7.62 mm).

current_contact_materialization.finding: Numeric passthrough does not preserve the two sequential Cap rows represented in the M5 documentation when applied to Samtec alternating odd/even rows. An explicit map is required, but the correct handedness and physical assembly pose must first be established.

u214_product_page_1_gpio_ext_callout.limitation: An arrow identifies the underside male header, but the diagram does not label a mating-side view or tie one named function to an individually identified metal contact. The same grid is printed on the module's opposite, outward-facing sticker.

cardputer_adv_documentation_cross_check.limitation: This function-to-function bridge uses the documentation's odd/even host table, not a demonstrated Samtec pose. Cardputer's own schematic P3 uses a third sequential numbering convention: RESET1 through CS7 and GPS_TX8 through 5VIN14. Its product callout repeats the U214 grid despite the opposite mating face, so these numbers alone do not prove physical view handedness.

u219_product_page_1_inconsistency.finding: The analogous GPIO.EXT callout reverses the upper/lower row order relative to U214 and swaps CC_CS/NFC_CS relative to its own schematic and web pin table. It is not sufficient independent evidence for a production mating-face map.

conditional_maps_not_approved.coordinate_rule: All arrays map logical U214 PIN_1 through PIN_14 to Samtec physical pad numbers at the reviewed F0 pose. A 180-degree rotation rotates the whole Cap, not the Samtec footprint. No candidate is selected.

C_front_sticker_grid_hypothesis.condition: Assume the U214 outward sticker grid describes the contact positions viewed through the Cap from its outward face, with SMA on the left, exactly as the outward product photograph.
C_front_sticker_grid_hypothesis.visible_sma_side: left, conditional on this view hypothesis

D_C_rotated_180.visible_sma_side: right, conditional on the same view hypothesis as C

A_opposite_view_handedness.condition: If the U214 grid instead describes a direct male mating-face view, an additional reflection is necessary when converting it to the carrier female view. This row-reflected example and its 180-degree partner cannot be distinguished from C/D solely by choosing which way the Cap is rotated.
A_opposite_view_handedness.visible_sma_side: not established from the unlabelled mating-view callout

B_A_rotated_180.visible_sma_side: opposite A; absolute SMA side not established

mechanical_datum_separate_from_electrica.review: The published binary STL has 10480 triangles and four shell components: assembled and exploded upper/lower housing. It contains no fourteen metal contacts or numbered connector component. Public U214 product directory contains Structures only; no STEP or PCB CAD was present on the inspection date.
mechanical_datum_separate_from_electrica.established: 84 x 24 mm housing and a header aperture displaced toward a long edge. Header contacts are not centered across the 24-mm housing dimension.
mechanical_datum_separate_from_electrica.unresolved: Exact contact-row center to housing-edge Y datum and tolerance. Housing aperture edges are not a substitute for the undocumented contact-axis datum; dimensions must not be inferred by scaling the rendered image.
mechanical_datum_separate_from_electrica.release_scope: This missing mechanical datum does not itself forbid choosing a proven electrical assembly orientation. It remains a separate mechanical-fit obligation.

minimum_evidence_needed.electrical: Identify one actual asymmetric supply contact, preferably GND or 5VIN, in a direct view of the U214 male contacts, explicitly giving the row, the SMA end, and the NRST or housing-edge direction. A manufacturer annotated contact drawing, PCB CAD, or an unambiguous manufacturer photo is sufficient; STEP is not mandatory.
minimum_evidence_needed.mechanical: Provide X/Y coordinates and tolerances of the header mating-row center and the retention features relative to the 84 x 24 mm housing for the selected assembly orientation.
minimum_evidence_needed.external_question_en: For U214, viewed directly at the underside male contacts, with the SMA end explicitly indicated: please identify the physical location of GND (schematic pin 6) and 5VIN (pin 7), and clarify whether the GPIO.EXT diagram is a mating-side view or a view through the front label. Please also provide the contact-row center relative to the housing edges.
